resources.string: Prepare your document, then choose a printer
Documents you open for printing will appear here.
Close document and show recent documents
Pinch or double-tap to zoom. Drag the four handles to adjust physical page margins. Printer minimum margins are applied in the Android preview.
Tap a page to include or skip it. Long-press and drag to reorder. Use the range field below for exact numbers.
Android could not find an installed print service, so no printer may appear. Check Android print services and try again.
Sending pages to the print service: %1$d of %2$d
Numbers refer to the edited document order, including duplicate pages. Leave blank for all pages.
Uses the first selected page as the paper size for this job. Other page sizes follow the chosen scaling mode.
Content beyond the printable area is clipped. Check the preview before printing.
This explicit resolution defines the physical size of an image for Actual size and Source size. EXIF rotation is applied; bounded image decoding does not change that physical size.
Drag the preview handles or enter millimeters. Left and right always refer to the physical sheet. A printer may require larger minimum margins.
Drag left margin; numeric setting below
Drag right margin; numeric setting below
Drag top margin; numeric setting below
Drag bottom margin; numeric setting below
Grayscale renders pages, including text, at 300 DPI in small tiles to keep memory bounded. Large jobs may take longer to prepare.
Color preserves PDF text and vector graphics. Image sources use bounded decoding.

Choose copies, printer, and supported paper, color and duplex options in the Android print dialog. Jumlo cannot preset copies. The final system preview reflects the selected printer and its minimum margins.
Android and installed print services discover printers. If no printer appears, enable or install its print service in system settings, check its connection, and try again.
Save paper, margins, scaling, color and duplex preferences for next time.

These are Android print service states. Completed means the service reported completion; it does not verify printed paper. Android does not expose job progress percentages to this app. A private copy is retained for each job so it can be reused.
Print service status is temporarily unavailable. It will refresh while this screen is open.
Blocked — check printer or print service
Status no longer available from Android
Enter valid page numbers or ranges within this document, such as 1-3, 5.
The paper size, margins or scale cannot form a printable page. Reduce margins or change the paper size.
The print document could not be written. Check available storage and try again.
This private document is missing or cannot be safely reopened. Choose the document again.
This PDF does not permit printing.
This PDF requires a password. Import an unlocked copy for printing.
This format cannot be printed. Choose a PDF or a supported still image.
A printable annotation or form field has no usable appearance. Save a flattened copy in its original PDF editor, then print that copy.
Print data could not be saved. Check available device storage and try again.
Android printing or print-service settings are unavailable on this device.
Enter a preset name with 1–60 characters.
The document could not be prepared. Retry or choose another document.
